name: Yunnan Lincang Xinyuan Germanium Industry Co.,LTD
summary: Yunnan Lincang Xinyuan Germanium Industry Co.,LTD engages in the research and development, deep processing, germanium mining, pyrometallurgical enrichment, hydrometallurgical purification, and zone melting refining in China.
